fields.title: 📖 Understanding Kufr, Ẓulm, and Fisq together
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah names, in the connected verses, those who do not judge by what He has sent down as Kāfirūn, Ẓālimūn, and Fāsiqūn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The terms are weighty, but they are understood according to context and Iʿtiqād: denial is not like sinful deviation while acknowledging.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:45 und 5:47.
